facts.statement: Alexeyisaurus was first named by A. G. Sennikov and M. S. Arkhangelsky in 2010.
facts.quote: It was first named by A. G. Sennikov and M. S. Arkhangelsky in 2010

facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Alexeyisaurus karnoushenkoi.
facts.quote: the type species is Alexeyisaurus karnoushenkoi

facts.statement: Alexeyisaurus was initially considered an elasmosaur in its first publication.
facts.quote: While considered an elasmosaur in the initial publication

facts.statement: Later research reclassified the animal as a sauropterygian rather than a specific elasmosaur.
facts.quote: it has been described as a "partial, poorly preserved, and undiagnostic sauropterygian skeleton" in subsequent publications

facts.statement: Alexeyisaurus is an extinct genus of a possible plesiosaur.
facts.quote: es un género extinto de posible plesiosaurio

facts.statement: Alexeyisaurus lived between 227.3 and 211.18 million years ago during the Norian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Norian to Norian (227.3 to 211.18 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group for Alexeyisaurus is Elasmosauridae.
Alexeyisaurus belongs to the family Elasmosauridae.
